badges.line: You live on both sides of this one. Genii couldn't call it, and honestly, neither could you.

halves.name: Human Weighted Blanket
halves.desc: You keep everyone's feelings and every tradition safe: the birthday texts, the holiday dishes, the seat saved for whoever's late.

axes.line: Your people are your happy place. Close means shared.
You hold the person first. The hard part can wait for a gentler moment.
Traditions, rituals and how a home should run feel like home to you.

halves.name: Chill Personified
halves.desc: You don't race anyone's timeline. You go with the flow, and you like the flow familiar.

axes.line: Security first. Your leaps come with a safety net.
You run on your own clock. Other people's timelines are optional.
You read the room. Rules bend when a person needs them to.

stings: You check on everyone's feelings. Yours get checked if there's time left over.
You're not unambitious. Nothing has been worth the grind yet.
hearts: My life doesn't need a progress bar.

tags.name: Yes first, bank app later
tags.heart: Breaking my own rules for my people? No regrets.
tags.sting: One ask from a friend and your budget rules vanish. They only ever apply to you.

youToldGenii.said: Went, paid, and ate instant noodles for a week.
Said 'ten minutes.' Left three hours later.
Call, put them on speaker, "mhm" until one of us sleeps.

tags.name: Compliment sandwich chef
tags.heart: I say it softly so you can actually hear it.
tags.sting: You wrap the truth in so much sugar that some people only taste the sugar.

youToldGenii.said: Took them for bubble tea first. Brought it up on the walk back.
Rave about the verse. Mumble "maybe a louder chorus?" Change the subject.
Plan B: "Eh, some party. Their loss. Mini golf Saturday, loser pays."

tags.name: Same order, every time
tags.heart: I don't need new. I need mine.
tags.sting: You say you're open to new things. You've had the same order for three years.

youToldGenii.said: Stay. My people, my spots, my Thursday thing.
The one I could do half-asleep. Surprises are for birthdays.
My comfort show is on its fifth rewatch.

tags.name: Relationship mechanic
tags.heart: I don't quit on people I chose.
tags.sting: You'll fix what's broken, including things that aren't yours to fix.

youToldGenii.said: Sat them down and made an actual deal.
Make a shared doc with deadlines a day early. Secretly.

tags.name: Typos and all, my own words
tags.heart: My messy real words are the truest version of me.
tags.sting: You'd rather send the clumsy apology than the good one. Sometimes the clumsy one lands worse.

youToldGenii.said: Voice-noted my closest person. Four minutes, no summary.
Send my own version. It took 40 minutes and says sorry six times.

calls.line: You've given up your charger, your seat or your last slice this week.
You've said 'it's so close!' about something that was not close.
Your top song of the year was also your top song last year.

plotTwist.line: You'd say: ‘Make them a playlist with a note on every song.’ Last time, you did: ‘Went, paid, and ate instant noodles for a week.’
